chronicle.title: The Chronicle of The Scarred Shore

events.text: Osric Stonehand digs the well that becomes Florara.
Roswen the Grey builds Temple of Feretta after a vision of Kell of the Grain.
Odile builds Tulino Sanctum after a vision of the Grey Judge.
Ysolde the Red breaks ground at Briica.
Kestrel Ironjaw moves the throne to Lavium.
Old Aururra is emptied by a war with the folk of the hills.
Liora the Quiet throws up the palisade that becomes Rocca Novanium.
Old Casenella meets its end: a flood that never fully receded.
An indecisive battle is fought at Brienanti against raiders off the coast.
Torvald Thistledown takes Castel Brienurra and walls it against a rival lord.
Bastian the Just strikes a rich seam at Corinessa Mines.
A fall underground at Teranino Mines takes eleven diggers.
Brynn the Bold throws up the palisade that becomes Narona Keep.
Ferinate Tower is built to watch the country for whatever comes down from the hills after dark.
Liora Ashfall keeps a lonely watch from Lavenoria Tower.

6.name: Castel Brienurra
6.text: Torvald Thistledown won Castel Brienurra in Year 378 from whoever held it before, and has kept it walled ever since against a rival lord, much to the discomfort of Old Belaniano.

12.name: Temple of Feretta
12.text: Roswen the Grey built Temple of Feretta in Year 28 after a vision of Kell of the Grain, and the shrine has kept its own small order of keepers ever since.

14.name: Ferinate Tower
14.text: Ferinate Tower was built by Aveline Fairweather in Year 398 to watch the country for whatever comes down from the hills after dark, and its lamp is said to still be lit some nights.

20.name: Briica
20.text: A handful of families under Ysolde the Red broke ground at Briica in Year 219, tenants of the lords of Narona Keep looking for better land.

24.name: Corinessa Mines
24.text: Bastian the Just struck a rich seam at Corinessa Mines in Year 378, and the diggings have never quite run dry.

41.name: Teranino Mines
41.text: Teranino Mines was opened in Year 386 and abandoned within a decade, after a fall underground took eleven diggers.

50.name: Florara
50.text: Florara grew up around a well Osric Stonehand dug in Year 7, at the point where the old track to Lavenoria Tower crossed the stream.

81.name: Old Belaniano
81.text: Old Belaniano was surveyed and mapped in Year 185. Locals say it is home to an old, half-blind troll, and no one has gone in far enough to say they are wrong.

84.name: Ravorno
84.text: antler-clan hunters still pass through Ravorno most years, pitching camp exactly where their grandparents did in Year 382.

113.name: Lavenoria Tower
113.text: Liora Ashfall climbed the rise at Lavenoria Tower in Year 479 and never really came down, keeping a lonely watch for bandits on the old road ever since.

120.name: Narona Keep
120.text: Narona Keep started as a wooden palisade in Year 393, thrown up by Brynn the Bold in a hurry against a rival lord, and was rebuilt in stone once the danger proved to be lasting.

123.name: Lavium
123.text: The throne moved to Lavium in Year 239, Kestrel Ironjaw judging the old seat too exposed to hold, and Ferinate Tower was the first to send tribute to the new court.

166.name: Helenasca Antica
166.text: Helenasca Antica was surveyed and mapped in Year 481. Locals say it is home to a nest of giant spiders, and no one has gone in far enough to say they are wrong.

193.name: Old Casenella
193.text: What Cael Fairweather raised at Old Casenella in Year 43 lasted only until Year 320, when a flood that never fully receded put an end to it; locals still leave offerings at the gate.

207.name: Valorno
207.text: No one now living can say who raised Valorno or why, only that it has stood since before living memory.

220.name: Rocca Novanium
220.text: Rocca Novanium started as a wooden palisade in Year 314, thrown up by Liora the Quiet in a hurry against a hungry winter's desperate poor, and was rebuilt in stone once the danger proved to be lasting.

228.name: Brienanti
228.text: Brienanti takes its grim reputation from Year 368, when a force met raiders off the coast there and neither side could rightly claim to have won.

261.name: Tulino Sanctum
261.text: Odile built Tulino Sanctum in Year 53 after a vision of the Grey Judge, and the shrine has kept its own small order of keepers ever since.

268.name: Aurenino
268.text: Ingra Stonehand settled Aurenino in Year 41, little more than a handful of houses at first, kept alive by the road to Briica.

274.name: Old Aururra
274.text: Sable the Tall built Old Aururra up from Year 8 onward, but a war with the folk of the hills emptied it by Year 244, and its stones have since been carried off to build up Ravorno.
